name: OpenScale
author: kematzy
description: OpenScale credit balance in the bar, with a panel for usage, models and settings.

barWidget.description: Credit balance remaining. Click for usage, models and settings.

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the balance is read from the osc CLI while the panel is closed. 30 seconds minimum, for development.

schema.label: Open-refresh minimum gap (seconds)
schema.description: Opening the panel refreshes the balance unless the last good fetch is younger than this. 0 refreshes on every open.

schema.label: Low balance alert (USD)
schema.description: Highlight the balance in the bar and panel header when it falls to or below this amount.
